prompt: Build me a wireframe for an IONOS hosting product landing page with a hero section (dark background, headline, subline, CTA button) and a 3-column feature card row below it (web hosting, VPS, domains). Output a .tsx file.

assertions.text: ThemeProvider with brand='ionos' wraps the output
ThemeInverter (or equivalent) is used for the dark hero section
Colors reference CSS custom properties (var(--...)) rather than hard-coded hex values
Hero section contains a Button component with a CTA label
Three Card components cover Web Hosting, VPS, and Domains (or equivalent)
Headline uses Overpass font family (via CSS token or font-heading class)
File has a comment marking it as a wireframe illustration
Event handlers are stubbed as empty functions () => {} rather than real logic
